blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As a veteran diplomat and legal scholar, Tommy Koh of Singapore has always believed that no country—no matter how small—should be bullied and trampled on by a major power. Defending the rights of smaller states and amplifying their voice in the international stage has earned Koh the Ramon Magsaysay Award this year,
